author: ballzi
body: So lately my Minecraft has been lagging. On the menu screen I get 15 FPS and ingame I get 12-13 solid. I have had this problem before but it was a recording software. I think it is something else. Can you guys help me?

replies.body: Reset it to factory settings, I am serious, I had to do this after I downloaded a file that took 3 days and make my Minecraft stay at 5-10 FPS.
